scientific_integrity: Proof uses stationary two-sided Poisson renewal and a coefficient sign argument. Standard-library exact-rational verifier is finite testing, not universal or independent proof. Primary novelty is sharp anisotropic sign phase diagram and threshold bound.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform-sphere Poisson orientation redraws; positive diagonal harmonic traps and independent Brownian baths only. Off-diagonal traps, anisotropic turning kernels, nonlinearities, and time-dependent covariances are outside scope. The isotropic specialization follows known earlier work; general tensor recurrence may subsume anisotropic moment identities.
title: A dimension-five sign transition for anisotropic harmonic run-and-tumble energies
